description: This file defines the MockHandler class used for testing purposes in the GuzzleHttp library. It simulates HTTP responses or exceptions from a queue, allowing controlled testing of HTTP client behavior.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A handler that returns responses or throws exceptions from a queue for testing purposes. Implements the Countable interface to manage its internal queue.

methods.name: createWithMiddleware
methods.description: Creates a new HandlerStack with a MockHandler instance, allowing middleware stacking for testing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockHandler with an optional queue of responses, callables, or exceptions, and optional callbacks for fulfilled or rejected promises.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles an incoming request with given options, returning a promise that resolves to a response or rejects with an error, simulating HTTP behavior.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds responses, callables, or exceptions to the internal queue for future handling.

methods.name: getLastRequest
methods.description: Retrieves the last HTTP request that was processed by the mock handler.

methods.name: getLastOptions
methods.description: Retrieves the options used in the last request processed.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears the internal queue, resetting the handler state.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Internal method to invoke the on_stats callback with transfer statistics.
